name: TATA-box binding protein associated factor 1
pathways: mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TAF1 encodes transcription initiation factor TFIID subunit 1250). Annotated molecular activities include kinase activity and protein kinase activity. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked, syndromic 33 (x-linked); X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
